label: Initial temperature
subgoals: Record the costs of N random accepted moves
Compute the standard deviation of those costs
Multiply by 20 to get the initial temperature

label: Adaptive cooling
subgoals: Read the acceptance rate of the finished temperature
Pick alpha from the four acceptance-rate bands
Multiply the temperature by alpha for each step

label: Effort and exit
subgoals: Compute InnerNum times N to the 4/3 moves per temperature
Compute the exit threshold from cost per net
Count the cooling steps until the temperature falls below it
